title: When the Contact Breaks
author: Lior Ishikawa
blurb: Oscar Sandoval, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
